dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent ring-shaped structures exhibit irregular, jagged perimeters with high-frequency serrations at the interface between the dark exterior and lighter interior. The contrast transition is sharp, defining clear but non-uniform circular and cloud-like boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of amorphous, localized light-intensity clusters located primarily in the mid-dorsal and upper-right regions. These clusters appear as solid, low-gradient patches concentrated between the larger macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the upper-central region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with a secondary smaller triangle of high-intensity blobs located along the right-lateral margin.
